frozen: 2026-11-02, before any test or Chaksu row of this method was read; chosen by the user
name_status: working name; final name not chosen
encoder: medsiglip, pooled image feature, standardised on train

head.selection: best epoch by validation bAcc on the sites of that head

site_projection.method: NAP, within-class between-site directions, fitted per head on its training rows

bag: one head per development source, each trained without that source; logits centred per image, scaled by their std on validation, averaged

text.scale: centred per image, scaled by std on validation, averaged

calibration: none in the method; raw, TS and FTS on Cal-A as for every baseline
disclosure: About 120 configurations were compared on 7 development sites by leave-one-source-out. Baseline test results had been seen before this method was designed. A variant with mirror features (dev bAcc .800) was not chosen and would be post hoc if run on test after this.
